🦠 Breaking: HMPV virus spotted in Kolkata!
Peerless Hospital says only 3 mild cases since November. Looks like HMPV is just here for a light winter vacation. 🏖️ Don’t worry—wash hands, stay chill, and stay safe!
#HMPV #HealthUpdate #Kolkata
